reason: The Didit webhook's X-Signature-V2 header only picks which signature format is checked (canonical body vs raw bytes). Both branches are an HMAC-SHA256 of the body with DIDIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET and a constant-time compare (verifyDiditSignatureV2 / verifyDiditSignature in apps/api/src/kyc/didit.ts), so a caller without the secret passes neither. False positive.
